text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Joseph Mugalla elected secretary-general of the Central Organisation of Trade Unions.
- President Daniel arap Moi releases 9.26 million shillings he helped raise to assist families of the victims of the 1994 Mtongwe ferry disaster.
- The high court stops the Kenya Wildlife Service from removing or translocating the Hirola antelope from its natural habitat until a suit filed by area residents is heard.
- Political parties in the country come under fire for allegedly ignoring womens' issues.
- Prominent sugar dealers are conspiring with top managers of sugar factories to hoard the commodity.
- Tension is building between Maasai and Kamba communities following cattle raids.
- A Mombasa court hearing a two billion shillings hashish case is told that a chief cannot be charged as he was not positively identified.
